board: Sensirion SEN55-SDN-T with a 6-wire JST GHR-06V cable (connector pins VDD, GND, SDA, SCL, SEL, NC)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint): start 0x0021, data-ready 0x0202 and read-measured-values 0x03C4 (8 words: uint16 PM /10, int16 RH /100, T /200, VOC/NOx /10, Sensirion CRC per word) modelled per datasheet section 6. SDA/SCL need external 10 kOhm pull-ups to 3.3 V; pullUp was not set (as for SPS30) because Sparkbench would tie them to the 5 V supply, so build notes tell the user to fit them; SEL is modelled as a GND pin.
